criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Case and Death Statistics
categories.definition: Queries seeking numerical data regarding infections, deaths, recoveries, or testing rates.

categories.name: Prevention and Precautions
categories.definition: Queries about measures, behaviors, and equipment to avoid contracting or spreading the virus.

categories.name: Treatment and Remedies
categories.definition: Queries regarding medical treatments, cures, vaccines, or home remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms and Diagnosis
categories.definition: Queries identifying or verifying symptoms of COVID-19 or asking if specific sensations indicate infection.

categories.name: Transmission and Risk Factors
categories.definition: Queries about how the virus spreads, survival on surfaces, and identification of high-risk groups or areas.

categories.name: Travel Advice and Restrictions
categories.definition: Queries concerning travel safety, restrictions, bans, or transportation status.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: Queries requesting the latest news, recent developments, or status updates for specific locations.

categories.name: Donations and Financial Support
categories.definition: Queries expressing intent to donate money or asking how to support relief funds and charities.

categories.name: Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: Queries asking to verify or debunk specific rumors, conspiracy theories, or fake news.

categories.name: Animals and Pets
categories.definition: Queries specifically regarding the impact of COVID-19 on animals, pets, or transmission via animals.

categories.name: General Information
categories.definition: Broad queries seeking definitions, general facts, or comprehensive overviews of COVID-19.

categories.name: Sharing and Social Actions
categories.definition: Queries requesting to share information, articles, or links with others.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: Utterances consisting of greetings, thanks, or appreciation without a specific information request.
